doc: One clump of flowers to grow: what the game asks for ("oxeye daisies in summer"), plus the seed that makes this clump differ from its neighbours and the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness: the clump's layout and which stems are in flower.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from distance and quality.
